segments.title: It shot its TONGUE like a chameleon
segments.say: Scientists just named a tiny animal that shot out its tongue like a chameleon.

segments.title: Smaller than your thumb
segments.say: Its whole family was less than five centimetres long.

segments.title: Eyelids, claws, scales
segments.say: It had eyelids. Claws. And dry, scaly skin.

segments.title: Lived right before the asteroid
segments.sub: Found just below the **dinosaur extinction** layer
segments.say: It lived in Spain, right before the asteroid that wiped out the dinosaurs.

segments.title: Its family SURVIVED
segments.sub: They lasted until about **2 million years ago**
segments.say: And its family survived. They lasted until about two million years ago.

segments.title: Named from 80+ bones
segments.say: It was named from more than eighty bones, in the journal Cretaceous Research.
